Unlike category 2 (สถาปัตยกรรม) and category 4 (ไฟฟ้า) rollups, this sheet DOES print 3.1/3.2/3.3 in the ลำดับที่ (item_no) column as proper separate values, each with quantity 1 and unit 'รวม' - confirmed at 2x zoom, a genuine formatting difference between categories, not a transcription inconsistency (see the same observation recorded on หน้า68_2's warnings).

3.3's description here reads 'งานระบบสุขาภิบาลภายนอกอาคาร' (with a 'งานระบบ' prefix); the detail sheet for this same sub-category (หน้า75_1, แผ่นที่ 17/22) headers itself 'ระบบสุขาภิบาลภายนอกอาคาร' (no 'งานระบบ' prefix) - a minor but real wording difference between the rollup and the detail sheet, transcribed exactly as printed on each sheet rather than forced to match.
All unit-price/amount columns are blank in the source for every row, including the 'รวมข้อ 3' subtotal row - transcribed as null, not invented.
